outlet: WA Secretary of State election results, precinct export
notes: Stevens County precinct results, November 3, 2020 general (58 precincts). 'Stevens Commissioner #1' and '#3' appear in all 58 precincts (commissioners elected county-wide in the general, RCW 36.32.050(1)); 'PUBLIC UTILITY DISTRICT - 001 Commissioner #2' also appears in all 58 (19,741 votes), consistent with a county-wide PUD electorate (RCW 54.12.010(3)). County totals: PUD Commissioner #2 Howie Kubik 19,399, write-in 342; Court of Appeals Division 3 District 1 Position 2 Tracy Arlene Staab 12,829 (55.35%), Marshall Casey 10,202, write-in 148; Superior Court Position 2 Jessica Taylor Reeves 18,828 (unopposed).
